editorial:
Imagine your worst nightmare coming true while thousands of people watch you live on camera. You follow Amy, a popular online streamer who thinks she has everything under control until a mysterious person starts blackmailing her. This movie traps you in a single, terrifying night where Amy is forced to do things she hates just to keep her secrets safe. It feels like a high-stakes game of cat and mouse that starts out slow but quickly turns into a nightmare. You will feel the panic as the walls close in and the threats get more personal, making you wonder how far you would go to protect your reputation.

The acting is top-notch, especially since most of the movie relies on Amy's reactions to things happening off-screen. The twists are genuinely surprising and keep you guessing until the very end. While some parts might feel a bit repetitive, the tension makes up for it. If you love thrillers that make your skin crawl, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a huge twist when you find out the blackmailer was actually someone from Amy's past who felt betrayed by her rise to fame. In the final scene, Amy manages to trick the attacker into revealing their identity on the live stream. Even though she survives the night, the movie wraps up by showing that her secrets are now public. She wins the fight but loses her perfect online image forever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and stories about the dark side of social media.
